lesson: The system consistently entered LONG positions during Wyckoff distribution phases and overextended RSI conditions, effectively trying to catch falling knives in a local downtrend. It incorrectly prioritized higher-timeframe bullish bias while ignoring immediate signs of exhaustion and bearish order flow.
adjustment: Implement a mandatory 'No-Long' filter when the 1h RSI exceeds 75 or when price is trading above the upper Bollinger Band, regardless of the daily trend.
methodology_flag: Trust Wyckoff distribution signals more than higher-timeframe trend bias for short-term entries.
